paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Jesu Khrist sawltak hi ding a sap leh i unaupa Sostheni in,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

paite: Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte, Khrist Jesu a sehtuam siangthoute, misiangthou hi ding a sapte leh gam chih a i Toupa, amau leh eite Toupa, Jesu Khrist min lou tengteng kiang ah;
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Khrist Jesu a Pathian hehpihna noute kiang a hong kipiak ziak in na tungthu uah Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige a;
heading: Kipahthu Genna
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

paite: bangkim ah thugen peuhmah ah leh theihna chiteng ah, amah ahihhauh in na om uhi.
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

paite: Huchi in Khrist thu ka theihsak pen noumau ah hihkip in a-om hi.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

paite: Huan i Toupa Jesu Khrist kilakna ngak kawm in, khalam thilpiak himhim na tasam kei uhi.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist ni chiang a gensiatbei a na omna ding un, atawp pha in hon hihkip behlap ding hi.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: A Tapa Jesu Khrist i Toupa toh kithuahna nei ding a nou hon samlutpa, Pathian amuanhuai hi.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

paite: Huan unaute aw, na vek un thu kibang na gen ua, na lak ua kikhenna himhim a-omlouhna ding in lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat a diktak a na kizop tinten zawkna ding un Toupa Jesu Khrist min in ka hon ngen ahi.
heading: Saptuam Sung A Kipawlkhenna
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na tungtang thu uh, na lak uah kiselna a-om chih Kloi inkuanpihte'n hon hilh uhi.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

paite: Hiai ka chihna ahi, nou sung a khat-le-khat in, "Kei Paul pawl ka hi, kei Apollos pawl ka hi, kei Kifas pawl ka hi, kei zaw Khrist pawl ka hi," na chih uh.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

paite: Khrist khenzak in a-om a hia? Na sik un Paul kilhden in a-om a hia? Ahihkeileh Paul min in baptis in na om ua hia?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

paite: Khrispas leh Gaias lou ngal na lak uah mi kuamah ka hon baptis louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ahi.
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

paite: Huchi hi keileh zaw mi'n keimah min a baptis na hi uh achi kha ding uhi.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

paite: Stephenas inkuanpihte bel ka baptis ngei a, tuate lou zaw midang ka baptis hia ka thei kei.
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

paite: Khrist in baptis ding in hon sawl kei a, tanchinhoih gen ding in ahon sawl zaw hi; thupil a gen lou in, huchi lou in zaw Khrist kros thilhihtheihna bangmah lou asuaksak kha ding uhi.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

paite: Kros thu zaw mangthang lelte a ding in haina ahi ngal a; ei hotdam lelte a ding in bel Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pathian Pilna leh Thilhihtheihna Khrist Ahi
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

paite: "Mipil' pilna ka hihmang ding a, lemthei' lemtheihna leng ka paikhe ding," chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

paite: Mipil koi ah ahia? Laigelhmi koi ah ahia? Hiai khovel a selhatmi koi ah ahia? Pathian in khovel pilna haihuai ahi chih atheisak kei a hia?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

paite: Pathian pilna ah bel, khovel in apilna zang a Pathian atheihtheih louh nung in thugen haihuai zang a agingtate hotdam akipah lam ahi.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

paite: Judate'n chiamtehnate aphut ua, Grikte'n pilna'n azong uh.
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

paite: Eite'n bel Khrist kilhden thu i gen ua; huai tuh Judate a ding in pukna, Zentelte a ding in haina ahi.
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

paite: Himahleh Judate leng hi hen aw, Grikte leng hi heh, sapte a ding in zaw Khrist, Pathian thilhihtheihna leh Pathian pilna pen ahi.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

paite: Pathian haina mihing sang in apilzaw a, Pathian hatlouhna leng mihing sang in ahatzaw hi.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

paite: Unaute aw, ahon sapna ngaihtuah dih ua, salam a mipil tampite, mihat tampite, mihoih pipite, sap ahihlouhdan uh;
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

paite: himahleh Pathian in mipilte azahlaksak theihna ding in khovel thil haite atel a; huan Pathian in khovel thil hatloute atel a, ahatte azahlaksak theihna ding in;
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

paite: khovel thil niam leh simmohhuaite, thil omloute tan in Pathian in atel a; thil omte bangmah lou a abawltheihna ding in.
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

paite: Huchi in Pathian ma ah mi kuamah aki-uangsak thei kei ding uh.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

paite: Amah ziak in noute Khrist Jesu ah na om uhi; Pathian in Khrist i pilna, i diktatna, i sianthouna leh i tatna hi ding in abawlta hi,
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

paite: hichi a gelh ahih bang in, "Asuang peuhmah in Toupa suang hen."
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
